investigations.evidence: The installed Torch 2.15 DTensor found_inf_reduce_handler creates Partial(max) placements, materializes the full tensor, and copies the reduced flag back. LeRobot's documented cross-rank behavior is implemented below its own source layer.
The open PR already adds the missing in-memory MPS snapshot and restoration, with tests. PR #4014 also explicitly deferred this same path as a follow-up.
The current dataset factory raises NotImplementedError before constructing MultiLeRobotDataset. No current training-path claim is made.
